reason: term "or his delegate" defined one way when referring to Secretary of Treasury and construed similarly for any other US official.
ocaml:
type official_reference =
  | Secretary_of_treasury
  | Other_official

let meaning_of_or_his_delegate (ref_official : official) : delegate =
  if references_secretary_of_treasury ref_official then
    (* officer, employee, or agency of Treasury Department duly authorized by Secretary,
       directly or through one or more redelegations, to perform function in context *)
    duly_authorized_treasury_delegate ref_official
  else
    (* similarly construed for any other official of United States *)
    duly_authorized_delegate_of_other_official ref_official

let duly_authorized_treasury_delegate (ref_official : official) : delegate =
  is_officer_employee_or_agency_of_treasury ref_official &&
  authorized_by_secretary_directly_or_by_redelegation ref_official

let duly_authorized_delegate_of_other_official (ref_official : official) : delegate =
  is_officer_employee_or_agency_of_official ref_official &&
  authorized_by_official_directly_or_by_redelegation ref_official

reason: condition on Guam/American Samoa function selects between general delegate meaning alone or general meaning plus (B)'s additional inclusion, itself a conjunction of requirements.
ocaml:
let meaning_of_delegate (ref_official : official) (context : guam_american_samoa_context) : delegate =
  if pertains_to_guam_or_american_samoa_functions context then
    meaning_of_or_his_delegate ref_official ||
    meaning_of_delegate_guam_or_american_samoa ref_official context
  else
    meaning_of_or_his_delegate ref_official

(* 7701(a)(12)(B) — extension for functions performed in Guam or American Samoa
   under chapters 1, 2, and 21 *)
let meaning_of_delegate_guam_or_american_samoa (ref_official : official) (context : guam_american_samoa_context) : delegate =
  performed_in_guam_or_american_samoa context &&
  taxes_imposed_by_chapters_1_2_21 context &&
  is_officer_or_employee_of_other_department_agency_or_possession ref_official &&
  authorized_by_secretary_directly_or_by_redelegation ref_official
